q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of a miniature circuit breaker?
title: MCB carbon footprint per piece
short: Add the moulded housing, copper and silver contacts, bimetal strip and coil per breaker with supplier figures. Then add moulding, assembly and calibration testing electricity, and divide by breakers passed, by pole and rating.

ul: Copper, silver alloy contacts and bimetal strip.

p: Report per breaker by poles and current rating. Multi-pole breakers carry more contacts and housing, so report them separately.

example.title: Worked example: miniature circuit breaker unit per piece (one month)
lines: Plant total: 21,300 / 200,000 = 0.106 kg CO2 per piece
Add housing and contacts for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
